pagecreationwizard: Display name of the special page shown in the page title and navigation. Required by MediaWiki — must match the special page registration name (lowercased).
pagecreationwizard-intro: Introductory paragraph shown above the form.
pagecreationwizard-ns-main: Option label for the main (public) namespace.
pagecreationwizard-ns-intern: Option label for the Intern: namespace.
pagecreationwizard-pagetitle-label: Label for the page title text input.
pagecreationwizard-pagetitle-placeholder: Placeholder shown inside the title field when empty.
pagecreationwizard-submit: Submit button text; clicking it redirects the user to the standard MediaWiki edit page.
